Dialogue_Text: "Three Thirsty Rascals—that is how some referred to the kobold brothers that were seen near the nearby cave. Some said their thirst was even greater than that of some vampires. People that walked into these caves rarely left. But the villagers were clear about their wish: they wanted the kobolds gone. That is why they sent a group of adventurers that called themselves The Vampire Slayers."
Vampires or not, work is work.
The cost for fighting the Three Rascals is 3,500 gold pieces. Would you like to face them?
Yes, I do. Here's the money, viscountess.
No. I'll pass. At least for now.
Thank you. Remember to make sure they are truly gone. Only then shall their story truly end.
